profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior software engineer with 15 years of experience in release engineering and platform engineering. I build the CI/CD infrastructure, release tooling, and developer platforms that let engineering orgs ship reliably at scale. I'm driven by work that makes others more productive: removing friction and toil from dev workflows and freeing teams to focus on what they do best.

positions.title: Release Engineer - Validated Release
positions.description:
Owned the quarterly release process across 100+ customer tenants. These are life sciences companies requiring scheduled, change-controlled releases rather than continuous deployment.

Transformed the quarterly validated release from a high-effort manual operation (two engineers dedicating 3-4 full weeks, often involving crunch time) into an automated process that one engineer can handle at half capacity in ~1-1.5 weeks. This was a ~90% reduction in engineering effort.

Enforced change control in a regulation-adjacent environment, triaging engineer requests for compliance with customer validation agreements and collaborating with the validation team on corrective actions to prevent recurring breaches.

Lowered the knowledge floor for operations that previously required deep domain knowledge. This was achieved through documentation, automation, and process refinement, which enabled new team members to meaningfully contribute from day one rather than requiring months of shadowing.

Built agentic skills to automate the multi-step upgrade workflow, which previously a checklist executed by release engineer manually (triggering and coordinating pipelines, creating pull requests, posting Slack messages, updating metadata across disparate systems, etc.). Enabled a single engineer to manage 5x the concurrent workload, with the reduction in cognitive load and manual coordination.

positions.title: Release Engineer - CICD
positions.description: Early member of the release engineering team, responsible for developer velocity and deployment reliability across a 200+ engineer org, shipping dozens of services multiple times daily. Established CI/CD SLOs and instrumented DORA metrics where none previously existed. Owned and continuously improved the end-to-end release pipeline from merge queue through staged environment promotion. Drove merge times from 2-3 hours to a consistent 30 minutes and deployment frequency from ~1/day to 4-7 releases daily.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack development on the Local Services team, building features for business owners in the home and local services space.

Shipped the after-hours responsiveness calculation for "Request a Quote", redesigning a long-standing business user painpoint. Rolled out with A/B experimentation and success analysis.

Served as tech lead on a team composed of junior engineers, leading design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions across multiple concurrent projects.

Ran a code review workshop for ~50 engineers across the division, covering best practices for writing reviewable PRs and conducting thorough, constructive reviews.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Platform engineering and infrastructure for a 700-engineer org across 1,300+ services with deploy-on-merge continuous deployment.

Designed and built EE Metrics (an in-house DORA-equivalent), giving engineering leadership visibility into CI health, test flakiness, dependency staleness, and deployment frequency. Architected as an extensible instrumentation framework so teams could define their own audits without modifying the core system. Still actively used and written about at Yelp today.

Scaled self-hosted Git infrastructure to handle growing CI load: implemented a tiered master-replica fan-out architecture for read scaling, high availability, and right-sized instance costs. Migrated off a single physical server to AWS. Implemented failover runbook, which was successfully employed in a live incident.

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
Responsible for managing the technical development of RigSense, a core product offering.
Led a team of 3 software developers.
Gatekeeper for code quality (code conventions, design architecture, best practices).
Provided technical direction to team members' designs.
Introduced formal design documents in the development cycle to reduce code churn from code review and acceptance testing.
Introduced one-on-one meetings with team members to provide opportunities for mentorship and career advice.
Gathered feedback from team regarding developer inefficiencies and pain points in their daily work and created concrete plans for improvement.
Continued to maintain responsibilities of prior role as a Software Engineer at National Oilwell Varco.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed solutions for instrumenting and monitoring oil rig drilling data.
Worked on RigSense (server-client monitoring application), Universal Viewer (remote client), and WellData (datastore and website).
Main technologies: C#, .NET, WCF, SQL, ASP.NET, TFS, Git.
Used Kanban development process to deliver releases regularly.
Introduced and formalized code review process into development cycle.
Hosted learning seminars on various topics (Git, time management, code reviews) to assist team in learning new tools and processes.
Became the go-to person for technical knowledge in multiple domains (Git, C#).

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented data warehouses to process business intelligence data.
Used Windows Workflows and AppFabric technologies to run long-lived workflows processing ~100-500 GB of data daily.
Designed and deployed releases to database systems of 1-5 TB in size.
Aggregated >5 years of data at multiple granularity levels: daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly.
Wrote and tuned SQL queries used to generate analytic data and key performance indicators. 
Used SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) to move and transform large sets of data.
Assisted service engineers to ensure service level agreements were met and latency of business decisions was minimized.
Designed OLAP cubes with SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS) that allowed executives to directly query report data and make business decisions.

positions.title: EDR Intern
positions.description:
Performed capacity and performance testing of Electronic Drilling Recorder.
Provided Tier 2 support, which involves detailed technical investigations into issues reported from systems in the field.
Cross collaborated with software, hardware, and IT teams to resolve issues from performance tests.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Develop tool for QA to mock test features within the QuickTax software.
Reduced website load time by optimizing external resources during build process (combining external scripts, minifying).
Created shell scripts for instantiating remote virtual machines for development and test environments.

positions.title: Junior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Wrote SQL queries for generating reports from market research data.
Wrote Python and Bash scripts to automate processes.
